mission.title: Toynbee Hall works alongside people facing poverty and injustice to build a fairer and happier East London.
mission.body: Based in the East End of London since 1884, we are a charity that provides vital support and works in partnership with local communities to tackle unfairness and ensure everyone has an equal chance to thrive.

items.title: What this Budget must deliver for a stronger social safety net
items.summary: As the Chancellor prepares to deliver the Budget, this is an opportunity to set out what it must deliver for people and communities.

items.summary: A recent visit to London explored what the UK and South Korea can learn about supporting people in debt.

venue.title: Make your next event matter.
venue.body: Our Grade II listed building is available to hire for conferences, meetings, community events and celebrations. Event production and catering can help make your event memorable, and every booking supports Toynbee Hall’s charitable work.
